customer_question: Our Zendesk-to-Jira workflow has been creating every Jira issue twice since last week.
resolution: A copy of the workflow made during testing was still active with the same Zendesk trigger, so both copies created an issue for each ticket. Deactivated the duplicate workflow, and added a Jira search step before the create step that looks for the Zendesk ticket ID in an issue label, so the workflow skips creation when the issue already exists.
